chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: Was Hilliard on the boat? His thin look and Fred Sparks
summary: The reed section on the boat; Hilliard's skinny look and Fred Sparks's quip.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Was Hilliard on the boat in St. Louis?

I think it was Chester Clark, Swazey and you; that was the brass section. The reed would have been Jeter, Hayes Pillars and maybe Hilliard, because Hollaway wasn't in the band still and Haymen wasn't in the band, so it had to be Hilliard.
I think maybe it was on the boat. I think Hilliard was on that boat.
Hilliard would have been a young guy too.
He was a good musician, wasn't he?
Was he a hard guy to get along with?
No, no. Everybody thought he had tuberculosis; he looked like he--
real skinny. He always was, he always stayed a skinny fellow.
